The '''Padua system''' was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the substance known as [[Padua water]].<ref name="Tales5">{{Tales|5|Lando's Commandos: On Eagles' Wings}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Padua water]]|system=Padua [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Padua [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-12.<ref name="TEA" />
